title: 科学技術英語
subtitle: English for Science and Technology
keywords: Scientific notation in English 2.Information retrieval in English 3.Structure and reading of scientific papers in English 4.Use of and notes on machine translation
educationalGoal: Knowledge of English specific to science and technology is essential to correctly read and write technical documents in English such as academic papers, patent specifications, and instruction manuals. In this course, we will learn about punctuation, articles, prepositions, countable and uncountable nouns, tense, and many other related topics, with a focus on English for science and technology. The goal is to acquire the minimum basic knowledge necessary to read technical documents and to transmit information in English.
advice: The goal of this course is to improve students' reading and writing skills, with a special focus on English for science and technology with respect to four particular skills. In order to carry out scientific research, it is essential to be able to retrieve information, to read literature, to create figures and tables, and to transmit information-all in English. In actual research and development, dictionaries, corpus, and machine translation tools (Google Translate, DeepL, etc.) that are available for free on the Internet are now being used frequently. We will perform exercises to learn how to make good use of these convenient tools as part of this course.
books: Textbooks:Richard Cowell, Jinhua She, "Mastering the Basics of Technical English, Definitive Edition," Corona Publishing Co., Ltd., 2015. Reference books:"Genius English-Japanese Dictionary," Taishukan Publishing Company. Reserved books:
requiredKnowledge: Students must be able to make adequate use of an English-Japanese dictionary. Students must be able to correctly read handwriting on the board, which will be in a slightly broken block style. It is not necessary to be able to read cursive writing.

activityGoals.body: Use English to retrieve information on science and technology.
Read and understand simple English sentences on science and technology without using a dictionary.
Translate English sentences into Japanese and simple Japanese sentences into English, using a dictionary.
Use machine translation to translate technical documentation.
